method: Actual migrations plus disposable SQLite/data models. Decision rows distinguish executed evidence, source facts, issue alternatives, external documentation, and judgment. Not a user experiment, runtime implementation, browser acceptance, or crawler test.

reusedPriorEvidence.limitation: Prior override-table necessity was conditional on retaining per-item manual state; that premise is removed here.

decisions.subject: article_toc
decisions.rationale: H1-H4 navigation and scrollspy are explicit requirements.

decisions.subject: light_dark_system
decisions.rationale: Reuse ThemeProvider and edgeever.theme; no second preference system.

decisions.subject: code_copy_language_collapse
decisions.rationale: Copy/highlighting already exist; add only missing labels and collapse controls.

decisions.subject: internal_hover_preview
decisions.rationale: Keep a bounded on-demand preview; do not inflate every directory item or fetch complete articles.

decisions.subject: image_and_diagram_controls
decisions.rationale: Reuse lightbox/zoom/fit; add single-click entry and fullscreen, not another viewer.

decisions.subject: body_full_text_search
decisions.rationale: Title-only search loses body matches; reuse existing FTS and Chinese fallback.

decisions.subject: tag_filter
decisions.rationale: Use the same search endpoint with a tag predicate; no global tag cloud/count API.

decisions.subject: custom_homepage
decisions.rationale: One JSON homeMemoId checked against live visibility; invalid targets fall back to directory.

decisions.subject: draft_exclusion
decisions.rationale: The issue permits draft state OR tags. Use existing note tags plus site excludedTags.

decisions.subject: custom_ordering
decisions.rationale: The issue permits manual OR title/number order. Use existing/title modes and numeric title sorting.

decisions.subject: custom_slug
decisions.rationale: Keep a unique slug and identity resolver; do not alter token-scoped unlock cookies.

decisions.subject: logo_header_footer
decisions.rationale: Keep structured display settings and HTTPS logo URL; no independent upload pipeline.

decisions.subject: seo_and_social_cards
decisions.rationale: Keep server HTML head and indexing controls; crawler acceptance remains unverified.

decisions.subject: two_or_one_item_override_tables
decisions.rationale: No per-item state remains when exclusion uses tags and sorting uses titles.

decisions.subject: independent_site_title
decisions.rationale: Use root notebook name; independent override is an additional product choice.

decisions.subject: independent_site_description
decisions.rationale: Use visible homepage or article excerpt; no separate description field.

decisions.subject: site_slug_column
decisions.rationale: One column with a case-insensitive unique index keeps lookup and uniqueness simple.

decisions.subject: home_memo_id_column
decisions.rationale: Live validation already handles moves and soft deletion; a single stale pointer is bounded.

decisions.subject: logo_url_column
decisions.rationale: Bounded display metadata does not need an independent SQL column.

decisions.subject: header_links_column
decisions.rationale: Preserve structured links in the bounded settings object.

decisions.subject: footer_text_column
decisions.rationale: Preserve footer text in settings.

decisions.subject: allow_indexing_column
decisions.rationale: Effective indexing checks the JSON flag and current password; setting passwords clears the flag.

decisions.subject: excluded_tags_column
decisions.rationale: JSON tags are filtered against existing memo_tags before pagination.

decisions.subject: two_sort_mode_columns
decisions.rationale: Use one existing/title mode for the site; no separate note/chapter controls.

decisions.subject: separate_site_get
decisions.rationale: Extend authenticated share GET with owner settings.

decisions.subject: site_settings_patch
decisions.rationale: Preserve existing password PATCH semantics; config-only writes do not rotate passwords.

decisions.subject: content_management_get
decisions.rationale: No site-specific item editor is needed.

decisions.subject: per_note_exclusion_patch
decisions.rationale: Use existing note tag editing.

decisions.subject: manual_order_put
decisions.rationale: Title order requires no rank persistence or drag/drop command.

decisions.subject: public_search
decisions.rationale: Needed for body/tag search with server visibility and pagination.

decisions.subject: public_preview
decisions.rationale: Keeps preview responses bounded and avoids eager directory growth.

decisions.subject: alias_resolver
decisions.rationale: Return token identity only so SPA aliases use existing canonical API/cookie paths.

decisions.subject: complete_article_ssr
decisions.rationale: Keep SPA article rendering and server head; non-JS full-body crawlability is not retained.

decisions.subject: sitemap
decisions.rationale: It can improve discovery, but is not needed to implement the requested indexing switch/cards.

decisions.subject: new_content_index
decisions.rationale: Existing FTS and normalized tags already cover the queries.

decisions.subject: second_theme_storage
decisions.rationale: Same-origin app and public site share this device's appearance preference.

decisions.subject: second_image_diagram_renderer
decisions.rationale: Reuse existing renderers.

decisions.subject: publication_snapshot_version
decisions.rationale: Keep live sharing; no review/publish lifecycle.

decisions.subject: new_polling_or_push_invalidation
decisions.rationale: Reuse current refresh and error handling; do not claim instantaneous recall of loaded text.

decisions.subject: public_cdn_cache
decisions.rationale: Keep no-store and no-referrer.

decisions.subject: duplicate_runtime_business_logic
decisions.rationale: Cloudflare/Docker share visibility and metadata services with thin entry adapters.

decisions.subject: all_validation_layers_each_phase
decisions.rationale: Reuse unchanged checks and use three actual-flow acceptance scenarios after implementation.
